title: Code snippet generators must emit runnable environment variable references across all tabs
answers: What format should code examples use for API key authorization headers in playground tabs?
How should code snippets in EndpointPlayground reference authentication keys?
How to test code snippet generation in EndpointPlayground?
body:
Code example generators in products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx must generate immediately runnable code rather than placeholder markers.
All snippet generator functions (products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx:generateTerminalExample, products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx:generatePythonExample, and products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx:generateNodeExample) must read POSTHOG_PROJECT_SECRET_API_KEY using language-standard environment variable accessors ($VAR, os.environ, process.env).
All generator variants must be tested in products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.test.tsx across both populated payload and empty payload states to ensure consistency across tabs.
says: Copied code snippets from the playground fail because of placeholder tokens
Terminal and Python code examples should use copyable environment variable syntax
Make sample code in all playground tabs runnable right out of the box
Replace authentication token placeholders in playground snippets with environment variables
